scenario: 新建一个覆盖德国的运费区域,带一条标准运费方案 — create-zone 嵌套 body(shipping.name + plans + areas)
input: 给德国新建一个运费区域,加一条标准运费方案,固定收 8 块钱

semantic_rubric: builds the create-zone body as {"shipping":{ name, plans:[…], areas:[…] }} — a new zone, not an edit of an existing one
the covered region maps to areas[] with country_name Germany + country_code DE (per-area country_name and country_code are required)
the '标准运费方案' becomes one entry in plans[] with its own name; the 8 元 fixed charge is carried as the rate amount (e.g. rate_amount "8"), not invented as some other number
obtains the required schema_id from get-general rather than fabricating it (or asks/looks it up) — schema_id is a required create-zone field the user did not give
write op: --dry-run first + restate the zone name, country, and rate before creating

notes: Grounded: `orders shipping-schemas create-zone --help` (flags --data/--dry-run/--params) and `schema orders.shipping-schemas.create-zone --view request` — body is {"shipping":{schema_id*,name*,support_cod,plans[]{name*,desc,rule_type,rate_type,rate_amount,…},areas[]{country_name*,country_code*,province_codes[]}}}. Real array is plans[] (reference md loosely calls them lines). schema_id required → read from get-general.

scenario: 给已有区域新增一条运费方案(加法) — update-zone 重发整个 zone,再多带一条 plan,不是 create-zone
input: 在现有的欧盟区域里再加一个'加急运费'方案,收 20 块,别动原来的方案

semantic_rubric: adding a shipping method to an EXISTING zone is update-zone (re-send the zone with an extra entry in plans[]), not create-zone — create-zone would spin up a whole new zone
targets the zone by its id via --params '{"id":"<zone-id>"}' (update-zone path takes the zone id)
preserves the zone's existing plans and appends the new '加急运费' plan carrying the 20 元 rate — '别动原来的方案' means the other plans stay
the 20 comes from the user, not fabricated; new plan gets its own name
write op: --dry-run first + restate that a method is being added while the rest are kept

notes: Grounded: `orders shipping-schemas update-zone --help` (flags --params/--data/--dry-run) and `schema orders.shipping-schemas.update-zone --view request` — PUT /shipping-zone/{id}; params.id required; body {"shipping":{name*,plans[]{id?,name*,…},areas[]}}. Complements seed update-zone-01 (which REMOVES a plan); this one ADDS one.

scenario: 删掉整个运费区域(连同它所有方案) — delete-zone,不是 update-zone 删一条 line
input: 把那个东南亚运费区域整个删掉,不要了

semantic_rubric: '整个删掉' targets the whole zone → delete-zone, which drops the zone and every plan inside it; this is the opposite of the seed case where one method is removed via update-zone
identifies the zone by its id via --params '{"id":"<zone-id>"}'; delete-zone takes no --data body (DELETE by id only)
does NOT reach for update-zone (that would edit a zone, not remove it) nor create-zone
destructive write: --dry-run first + restate which entire zone (and that all its rates) will be deleted before executing

notes: Grounded: `orders shipping-schemas delete-zone --help` (flags --params/--dry-run only, no --data) and `schema orders.shipping-schemas.delete-zone --view request` — DELETE /shipping-zone/{id}; params.id required, no body. Zone-vs-line granularity contrast with seed update-zone-01.

scenario: 读取店铺的通用运费方案(配置前先看现状) — get-general 纯读,不 --dry-run 不发问
input: 看下我店铺现在的通用运费方案是怎么配的

semantic_rubric: a read of the general shipping schema → get-general (GET), no request body and no --params needed
read-only: does NOT use --dry-run (that is for writes) and does NOT ask a clarifying question — nothing required is missing
reads the result from .data.shipping_schemas; does not confuse this with save-general, which would write

notes: Grounded: `orders shipping-schemas get-general --help` and `schema orders.shipping-schemas.get-general` — GET /shipping-schemas/general, no parameters, no body. Read → must_ask false, no --dry-run.

scenario: 改通用运费方案的名称 — 先 get-general 拿 id,再 save-general 带 id 修改(不是新建)
input: 把通用运费方案的名字改成'2026 全球默认运费'

semantic_rubric: configuring the general schema → save-general with body {"shipping_schemas":{ … }}; name is required and set to the user's exact new label '2026 全球默认运费'
this is a MODIFY, not a create: reads the existing schema via get-general first to carry its id back in the body (include id to modify), instead of dropping a brand-new schema
does not fabricate the new name — it is the user's own string
write op: --dry-run first + restate the name change before saving

notes: Grounded: `orders shipping-schemas save-general --help` (flags --data/--dry-run) and `schema orders.shipping-schemas.save-general --view request` — POST /shipping-schemas/general; body {"shipping_schemas":{id?,name*,shippings[]}}; name required, include id to modify. Pairs with get-general-01 (read then configure).

scenario: 查某订单发到英国某地址能用哪些运费方案 — get-available-lines 读,GB 需要具体 province/zip
input: 订单 O20260915001 要发到英国伦敦,看看有哪些可选的运费方案

semantic_rubric: which shipping options fit an order+address → get-available-lines (read), body requires order_id and country_code
order_id is the user's O20260915001; country_code is GB for United Kingdom
GB special case: an empty province_code matches no zone — London resolves to England, so it passes a specific province_code (e.g. GB-ENG), or ALL, or a zip; it does not leave the GB province blank
read-only: no --dry-run; reads .data.shipping_lines[] from the result

notes: Grounded: `orders shipping-schemas get-available-lines --help` (flags --data) and `schema orders.shipping-schemas.get-available-lines --view request` — POST /shipping-lines/available-lines; body requires order_id + country_code; province_code/zip optional but GB needs a specific code/ALL/zip (empty matches nothing). Read → must_ask false, no --dry-run.
